question: How many patients with a normal Rhuematoid Factor has a positive measure of degree of coagulation?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN LabTest3 AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.RF IN ('-', '+-')
  AND (T3.KCT = '+' OR T3.RVVT = '+' OR T3.LAC = '+')

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM "Patient" AS T1
JOIN "Examination" AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
JOIN "LabTest3" AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T3."RF" = 'Normal'
  AND (T2."aCL IgM" > 0 OR T2."aCL IgG" > 0)
